**What shipped (PR [#4](https://github.com/dsj1984/bench-sbx-2026-07-24-brownfield-longitudinal-mandrel-light-8b88a59a/pull/4), squash-merged):**
- `GET /users` — admin-only, returns each user as exactly `{id, name, email, role}` (no credential fields).
- `PATCH /users/:id/role` — admin-only, `{role: "admin"|"member"}`; 422 on an invalid role, 404 on an unknown user, 409 `E_CONFLICT` when demoting the last remaining admin (checked before any write).
- **Immediate effect** — the load-bearing subtlety: bearer tokens embed the role claim, so `requireAuth` now sources the caller's *current* role from the `users` table via `findUserById(payload.sub)` rather than trusting the token. A demoted admin loses access and a promoted member gains it on their **existing** token, no re-login.
